name: TR505 lounge shuffle
desc: A softer, brushed RolandTR505 groove with a triplet-elongation shuffle: gentle syncopated kick, clap on the backbeats, closed hats swinging on a [hh@2 hh] shuffle while an euclid-rotating closed-hat and open-hat pattern slowly walks its accents around the bar. Warmer and more romantic than the swim kit — cocktail-lounge vaporwave.

code.full: stack(s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ sd ~").gain(${gain}*.85), s("[hh@2 hh]*2").fast(${rate}).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.2,${gain}*.38).fast(4)).pan(cosine.range(.4,.6).slow(24)), s("~ cp ~ ~ ~ cp ~ ~").gain(${gain}*.4)).bank("RolandTR505").lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7,${cut}*1.2).slow(28)).shape(.12).room(${room}).every(8,x=>x.late(.02)).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd ~ bd ~ ~ bd sd ~").shape(.16).gain(${gain}*.88), s("[hh@2 hh]*4").fast(${rate}).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.2,${gain}*.42).fast(8)).pan(sine.range(.3,.7).slow(14)), s("~ cp ~ cp").gain(${gain}*.4), s("oh(3,8,<2 4 6>)").gain(${gain}*.3)).bank("RolandTR505").lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.8,${cut}*1.4).slow(16)).shape(.15).room(${room}).every(4,x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(1).play()
